generated.description: A very large clay-built piece by Bambuspanda, about 403 blocks wide, 113 high and 17 deep, made of roughly 62,000 clay blocks. Glowstone accents (about 534) and a few quartz and stone brick blocks break up the surface, and the front view reads as a solid wall-like slab. The source gives no description and no interior, and the top view shows uneven heights along a long, narrow strip.
